value.rationale: The two canonical nonisomorphic strongly regular graphs with identical parameters and spectra and equal scalar ordinary zero forcing number are separated by a natural complete generating invariant. The finite exact obstruction hierarchy explains which white configurations cause the discrepancy, and a full 23-orbit decomposition describes all optimal Shrikhande configurations. This is a motivated structural classification rather than an arbitrary small-slice count.
